parts.text: Write a short LinkedIn-style post (under 100 words, English) about why our team switched to a new expense system.

Our old expense system took three weeks to process a simple receipt. 

We ditched it. 

The new software handles approvals automatically. You take a photo of the receipt, the app reads the total, and the money lands in your bank account by Friday. 

Finance stopped chasing lost paperwork. The engineering team got their weekends back. 

Time matters. Stop using software that steals yours.
